startingPrices.name: Starter Micro-Deliverable / Quick Creative & Site Update

en: Public entry-level pricing starts from ₹2,999 for focused starter deliverables only — never full custom websites, apps, or ongoing retainers.
Ad spend (Meta, Google), hosting, domains, paid plugins, licensed stock assets, AI/LLM API usage, and third-party SaaS tools are billed separately at actuals.
Every fixed project includes structured revision rounds (typically 2 rounds per milestone) — never chaotic 'unlimited revisions' that stall launches.
Fixed web & brand builds include a 30-day post-launch warranty & support window. Optional monthly care plans are available afterward.
hinglish: ₹2,999 starting price sirf chhote starter deliverables (jaise quick creative ya micro-audit) ke liye hai — poori custom website ya app ke liye nahi.
Ad spend (Meta, Google), hosting, domain, paid plugins, stock assets, AI API usage aur third-party software alag se actuals par bill hote hain.
Har fixed project mein clear 2 structured revision rounds per milestone hote hain — 'unlimited revisions' bolke kaam nahi latkate.
Fixed projects mein launch ke baad 30 days ka free support window included rehta hai; uske baad optional care plan le sakte hain.
